summary: Lower next() on a proven async generator to a Promise of a JavaScript IteratorResult while preserving queued request ordering.

target.notes: Return a JsPromise resolving to {value, done}; multiple next/return/throw requests must be queued and processed in order.

semantics.completed: next resolves to done true with undefined value

caveats: IAsyncEnumerator.MoveNextAsync returns bool and exposes Current separately, so a direct API substitution changes observable shape and request semantics.
